verdict.rationale: Customer.io documents an in-product agent that can analyze your workspace and performance. It can also run scheduled recurring analyses such as deliverability reports, segment audits and broadcast recaps, and help build segments from a plain-text description, all of which deliver AI-generated insights from your data inside the product. The evidence is short first-party claims only. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of what the insights and proactive suggestions actually contain, explicit evidence of unprompted recommendations, independent or hands-on corroboration.
